sentences.en: You must switch off the power before checking the circuit.
sentences.zh: 在检查电路之前，你必须关闭电源。

sentences.en: With this system a protection circuit has been built in.
sentences.zh: 有了这个系统，已经内置了保护电路。

sentences.en: The fuse blows or the circuit breaker is often activated.
sentences.zh: 保险丝会熔断或断路器经常被触发。

senses.zh: [电子] 电路，回路；巡回；一圈；环道
